brief:
Scholar Norman Finkelstein called Israel a "nation of child killers" during an interview with Tucker Carlson, according to Middle East Eye. He described Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as the "perfect reflection" of Israeli society in remarks that have drawn reaction online.

The interview sparked discussion across social media platforms, though the full context and Finkelstein's specific arguments were not detailed in available reports.
